P: Period: the time the body takes to go round the Sun once
P_Jupiter: Period of Jupiter, the time it takes to go round the Sun once, 11.86 years
P_Neptune: Period of Neptune, the time it takes to go round the Sun once, 164.8 years
a: Average distance of the body from the Sun (half the long axis of its orbit)
e: Eccentricity of the orbit: 0 is a circle, the bigger e the more stretched
r: Period ratio: how many times the asteroid goes round for each turn of Jupiter
